title: 0.2455%：险破0.3%，美联储9月为何按兵不动？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Have you seen enough to stop this fed from hiking in September?
segments.zh: 您是否已看到足够的数据，认为美联储9月不会加息？

segments.en: Yes, I think so. I mean, barely so, but I think so.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为如此。勉强算吧，但我觉得可以。

segments.en: I mean, today's core PC just barely rounded down to 0.2.
It's 0.2455, so we almost got a 0.3, which would have potentially rattled Marcus just to some extent as everybody sees their Bloomberg screen.
segments.zh: 实际为0.2455，差点就达到0.3，那可能会让市场有些波动，就像大家看到彭博屏幕上的数据那样。

segments.en: I think we're in an environment where the data will look a little bit cooler in the next couple of prints, such that the fed can avoid hiking and do it credibly.
segments.zh: 我认为接下来几份数据会显得温和一些，这样美联储就能避免加息，而且保持可信度。

segments.en: So we're going to see another round of inflation data that will probably come in on the software side.
segments.zh: 我们还会看到一轮通胀数据，可能偏向温和。

segments.en: The seasonals are in our favor. The fed officials all know that at the end of September, we're going to get some revisions to how they're calculating PCE and today's print portfolio
segments.zh: 季节性因素有利。美联储官员都知道，9月底PCE计算方式会有修订，而今天的核心PCE数据组合中，**组合管理服务上涨了5.6%。

segments.en: management was up 5.6%. That is a piece of the inflation data that's going to change in a couple of weeks.
segments.zh: 这是通胀数据的一部分，几周后将会改变。

segments.en: Therefore, it might bring some downward pressure to the data. So overall, we're likely to see an environment where the labor market data look a little bit softer from here.
segments.zh: 因此，这可能给数据带来下行压力。总体来看，我们可能会看到劳动力市场数据从现在开始有所软化。

segments.en: And the inflation data also cool, such that they can just sort of wait and see.
segments.zh: 通胀数据也会降温，这样他们就可以观望等待。

segments.en: And therefore, they don't ultimately have to hike.
segments.zh: 因此，他们最终不必加息。
